text:
emma_support: @sara_sre escalating: customer (acme-inc) reporting tool.invoke() 400 schema validation. They sent billing_profile as an array and session is missing. Error from gateway:
```
HTTP 400
{
  "error": "ValidationError",
  "message": "body.billing_profile: should be object, got array; body.session: required property missing; body.debug_mode: additionalProperties not allowed"
}
```
Repro steps:
1) Customer uses our web SDK to call /v1/tools/invoke
2) Payload is generated from older client lib
Full request body they sent:
```
{"model":"rwd-1","input":"hello","billing_profile":[],"debug_mode":true}
```
Customer is blocked and thinks billing still applied. /cc @nate_engineer @ben_infra

nate_engineer: looking now. can you attach the request id and full headers? suspect the validator on tools-gateway tightened yesterday (additionalProperties=false).

sara_sre: saw a deploy around 2026-03-16T04:12Z that touched the json schema for tool invoke. I'm checking canary and logs.

ben_infra: confirmed a config change merged that set stricter validation for billing_profile to be object only. intent was to catch malformed billing objects, but we missed compatibility test. Investigating fallback options.

customer_success: flagged as P1 with account team. customer reports being billed for calls they could not complete — needs urgent owner and ETA.

emma_support: pasting headers + curl for repro:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cust" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-1","billing_profile":[],"input":"hi"}'
```
Response matched the validation error above.

nate_engineer: quick mitigation ideas: 1) add a conversion layer that accepts single-element arrays and coerces to object when keys match, 2) temporarily relax schema to allow arrays (bad), or 3) rollback schema change (safe). I'll prototype conversion and raise a PR if rollback is undesired.

ben_infra: prefer rollback to restore customer experience, then ship a compatibility conversion in a patch. I'll coordinate rollback windows.

sara_sre: rolling back strict schema on canary now, monitoring errors and traffic. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: deploy started for service tools-gateway: v2.14.3 -> v2.14.2 (rollback) by sara_sre

nate_engineer: opened PR #3421 with a small conversion util + unit tests and a warning header X-RW-Compat: billing_profile-array to notify callers. Will add changelog note.

emma_support: thanks — told customer we are rolling back and working on compatibility. Keeping thread open for root cause postmortem and timeline for a permanent fix. :pray:
